data.description:
Origin: board DM msg 272 (2026-08-31), Forrest: 'let's get a favicon for our chat when we can. easier to find in the tabs.' Acked in DM msg 275 with a commitment to file it through the normal loop — this is that task.

Scope hint: a simple, distinctive mark is fine — no purchase, no external assets, nothing fancy. Serve it from apps/chat/public/ (note: server.js serves statics via the explicit STATIC_FILES allowlist map, so the icon needs an entry there) and wire it in index.html via <link rel="icon">. An inline SVG-as-favicon or small hand-made .svg/.png is fine. Goal is purely tab findability.
data.title: Chat: favicon for the chat app

data.body: CTO ordering call (board DM msg 323). Rank 7. Trivial and board-requested; ranked last-but-one purely because nothing depends on it. Honest note on the queue: at one lifecycle stage per tick, a chore this small still costs plan + implement + review ticks, which is why it has sat — the cost is the lifecycle, not the work.
Board directive (DM msg 394): all chat issues ship. Cluster order 6/6 — favicon last; ships with the cluster, not before it.

Chat cluster re-ordered 2026-09-03 (cto-owen, board DM msg 519). Order: AS-27 (planned) -> AS-75 (merge-to-deploy gap, high) -> AS-28 (this) -> AS-73 -> AS-74 -> AS-72 -> AS-61. Rationale for AS-75 ahead of the favicon: four merged chat tasks are not live in the container; nothing here is 'shipped' in the board's sense until merges deploy. Still assigned to Marcus as default internal-tools implementer; Lena may take it under lane doctrine if Marcus is on the D1 spine.

data.body: PLANNED (cto-owen, loop tick 3, watcher:76266; third lane under the WIP-3 rule — AS-99 implementing, AS-100 planned and held on AS-99's merge, AS-103 parked on the board's hook-spike answer per DM msg 673/676, so the age queue's oldest Chat task opens). Plan: a hand-written 32x32 SVG speech-bubble glyph in accent-500 with ink-white dots, one STATIC_FILES entry, one <link rel=icon> line, three api tests (served + content type, wiring substring, palette-only with a cardinality floor), five ACs with mutants. Deliberately an internal-tool tab marker, not a brand mark — BRANDING.md §5 (wordmark-only, no icon/monogram) stands, and Sofia may replace the glyph whenever a mark exists. Reassigned Marcus -> Lena because Marcus holds AS-99 (lane doctrine). Merge seam with AS-99 on index.html and STATIC_FILES is two adjacent one-line inserts; stated in the plan. Branch feat/AS-28-favicon, worktree .worktrees/AS-28. Implementation next tick.

IMPLEMENTATION STARTED (orchestrator cto-owen, loop tick 5, watcher:76266). Lena implements the AS-28 plan in .worktrees/AS-28 on feat/AS-28-favicon, as the second lane under WIP-3 alongside AS-99's implementation. Headless-tick constraints: host 'node --test' runs are labelled as such; the counted --build compose receipt waits for a session with docker (AS-92). Board writes stay with the orchestrator.

IMPLEMENTATION DONE (agent:developer-lena, loop tick 5 / watcher:76266), posted by the orchestrator from her report. Commit 8ee82bf on feat/AS-28-favicon: apps/chat/public/favicon.svg (593 bytes, viewBox 0 0 32 32, fills only — #1C41E3 = --color-accent-500 bubble, #FFFFFF = --color-ink-white dots; in-file comment states it is a tab marker, not a brand mark per BRANDING §5), STATIC_FILES entry in server.js, one <link rel=icon> line in index.html, three tests in test/api.test.js inserted beside the AS-32 style.css case (not at EOF, to keep the merge seam away from AS-99's appends). Branch diff: exactly those 4 files, +62/-0. Choices recorded: content type is the plan's literal 'image/svg+xml' with no charset suffix (unlike neighbouring entries; one-word change if the house prefers otherwise). ACs: AC-1 pass (M1 observed red), AC-2 pass (M2 observed red), AC-3 pass (M3 and M4 observed red; M4 failed via the cardinality floor '0 hex values examined, expected at least 2'), AC-4 host half pass (HOST node --test 367 -> 370, 0 failing), AC-5 pass (4 files; watcher IMAGE_INPUTS digests public/ as a tree hash so the AS-75 deploy sees the change without compose/Dockerfile edits). Mutants ran on a byte-identical scratch copy under scratchpad/developer-lena, site-anchored and re-read after mutation; none survived; scratch removed; worktree diff --exit-code clean. Finding from M1: its failing set is 2 tests, wider than the plan's 1 — the palette test fetches the SVG over HTTP, so deleting the allowlist entry makes it read a 404 body and trip the floor; correct behaviour, recorded so the doubled red is not mistaken for a leak. Owed: the counted docker compose run --build receipt (no docker in a headless tick, AS-92) before done; a visual 16 px light/dark tab-chrome check is QA's M6 probe (no browser, xmllint denied). Lena recommends review; suggested reviewer qa-priya.

REVIEW STAGE QUEUED (orchestrator cto-owen). Next tick runs the fresh-context QA review (qa-priya, Ruben is on AS-94) against git diff master...feat/AS-28-favicon inside .worktrees/AS-28, findings first and sweep second (M5), with the 16 px render probe and the compose --build receipt as the two known gaps. The reviewer must not read .lattice/review_state/ or any auto-review output before forming findings.

REVIEW STARTED (orchestrator cto-owen, loop tick 6 / watcher:76266). Fresh-context QA: agent:qa-priya, inside .worktrees/AS-28 against git diff master...feat/AS-28-favicon (8ee82bf). Findings first, sweep second (M5), M6 probes from the plan budgeted; reviewer told not to read .lattice/review_state/ or any other actor's scratchpad. Headless tick: the compose --build receipt is expected to remain owed unless docker answers by absolute path; a pass without the receipt holds at review, not done. Ruben reviews AS-99 in the parallel lane.

QA review (qa-priya, cold, cycle 1) of feat/AS-28-favicon @ 8ee82bf (1 commit, 4 files, +62; author developer-lena in the actor-id form). Inputs: plan, git diff master...feat/AS-28-favicon, BRANDING.md §5/§3.1, the running server from the worktree. Not read before findings: review_state/, any other actor's scratchpad, implementer comments. Scratch copy for mutants: scratchpad/agent-qa-priya/AS-28/scratch (worktree never mutated; git -C .worktrees/AS-28 diff --exit-code clean at 8ee82bf after the review).

FINDINGS (3 outside the criteria list; 1 blocking)

F1 [BLOCKING, implementation-level] AC-3's palette guard examines the wrong set: its regex /#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}/g matches the two hex strings inside the SVG's XML comment (line 4) as well as the four paint attributes, and it matches any 6-hex prefix rather than a whole paint value. Two mutants on the scratch copy SURVIVED (suite 370/370 green both times; site assertions confirm each landed on SVG lines 5-8, so these are guard gaps, not wrong-site mutations):
- M3c: fill="#1C41E3" -> fill="red", all three circles fill="#FFFFFF" -> fill="lime", comment intact -> 0 red. The cardinality floor (found.length >= 2) is satisfied by the comment's '#1C41E3 = --color-accent-500, #FFFFFF = --color-ink-white', so an artwork with zero palette colors passes 'uses only palette hex values' — the exact vacuous-pass shape the floor was written to prevent (plan §Tests: 'an SVG with no colors at all cannot pass vacuously').
- M3d: fill="#1C41E3" -> fill="#1C41E3FF" (8-digit hex with alpha) -> 0 red; the regex takes the first six digits and accepts it. #F00, rgb(...), and named colors are unmatched for the same reason.
The SVG itself is correct (both paints are the two tokens); the defect is the guard. Rework, test-only, in test/api.test.js: strip XML comments before matching; collect every paint value (fill=, stroke=, stop-color=, and style= if ever present) as whole attribute values; cardinality floor = paint attributes examined >= 4 (this artwork has 1 path + 3 circles); every value must equal one of the two tokens case-insensitively as a whole value. Add to AC-3, with observed reds required: M3c (named colors, comment intact) and M3d (#1C41E3FF), alongside the plan's M3a/M3b which must stay red.

F2 [non-blocking, record] M1 (drop the STATIC_FILES entry) reddened 2 tests, not the 1 the plan predicted: 'served with the SVG content type' AND 'uses only palette hex values' (the latter fetches /favicon.svg, gets the 404 JSON body, and the cardinality floor fires on 0 hex). Coupling through the route, not a defect; recorded because a set that differs from the prediction is itself a finding.

F3 [non-blocking, backlog if anyone cares] Content-type is image/svg+xml with no charset, unlike every neighbouring STATIC_FILES entry (; charset=utf-8). The plan specified it this way and the file is 100% ASCII (0 non-ASCII bytes of 593), so nothing depends on it; consistency only. Not changed.

Pre-existing behaviours observed while probing, outside this task's scope, not findings against it: HEAD /favicon.svg -> 404 (STATIC_FILES is GET-only for every static); //favicon.svg -> 200 text/html (WHATWG parses //x as a host, pathname /, so index.html — true of //anything).

SWEEP — floor check (AC-1..5), every mutant on the scratch copy, anchored to the site, applied (bytes asserted changed), restored byte-equal:
- AC-1 served: PASS. GET /favicon.svg -> 200, Content-Type: image/svg+xml, CSP default-src 'self', no-store, 593 bytes (plan cap 600), starts <svg, viewBox 0 0 32 32. M1 (delete server.js L40 entry) -> RED SET (2): {api: AS-28 — /favicon.svg is served with the SVG content type; api: AS-28 — the favicon uses only palette hex values}. Entry is load-bearing.
- AC-2 wired: PASS. Served / contains the exact link line. M2 (delete index.html L8) -> RED SET (1): {api: AS-28 — index.html links the favicon}.
- AC-3 palette-only: PASS ON THE LETTER, FAILS ON ITS STATED PURPOSE (F1). M3a (L5 fill -> #FF0000) -> RED SET (1): {api: AS-28 — the favicon uses only palette hex values}. M3b (strip every hex: comment L4 + fills L5-8 -> none) -> RED SET (1): same test (cardinality floor). Probes M3c/M3d: 0 red each — survivors.
- AC-4 suite: HOST PASS, COMPOSE OWED. HOST master baseline (main checkout, node --test): 367 tests, 0 fail. HOST worktree: 370 tests, 0 fail = baseline + 3. Scratch copy unmutated: 370/370. Counted compose run (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 /usr/local/bin/docker compose run --rm --build test; binary path from deploy-state.json) was DENIED at the permission layer in this headless session — no 'Image … Built' line, no compose number quoted, receipt still owed before done per the plan (AS-92).
- AC-5 nothing else moved: PASS. --stat = exactly favicon.svg (+9), index.html (+1), server.js (+1), api.test.js (+51); no JS, so the Escape chain and every element id in index.html are untouched by construction (the index.html diff is one <link> line). 'public' is in IMAGE_INPUTS (advance-watcher.mjs L78) and the Dockerfile COPYs it, so the AS-75 watcher redeploys with no compose/Dockerfile change — the plan's claim holds.
Sweep: 5 of 5 on the letter; findings outside the list: 3 (1 blocking).

PROBE LEDGER (M6)
- Path variants, raw socket: /favicon.svg/../favicon.svg, /../favicon.svg, /%2e%2e/favicon.svg, /./favicon.svg -> all normalized by WHATWG URL to /favicon.svg and answered 200 by the allowlist (exact-key map; the filename comes from the map, not the URL). /favicon%2Esvg, /favicon%2esvg, /FAVICON.SVG, /favicon.svg/, /public/favicon.svg, /%2Ffavicon.svg, /favicon.svg%00, /__proto__, /constructor, /favicon.ico -> 404 JSON from the allowlist. The AS-34 file gate never answers: /api/file?path=apps/chat/public/favicon.svg -> 404 'No such file.' byte-identical to a nonexistent path (no .md suffix); favicon.svg.md and index.html likewise.
- SVG content: read in full (9 lines). Only xmlns; no script, foreignObject, href/xlink, style, use, image, event attributes, no strokes (fill-only). role=img aria-label='ASC Chat' matches the page <title>; a favicon is not in the accessibility tree and 'ASC' is not rendered, so BRANDING §5.3's abbreviation rule is not engaged. No lettering, no monogram: the 'tab marker, not a brand mark' framing holds in the artifact.
- 16 px static geometry (viewBox 32, scale 0.5): body 14x10.5 px, corner r 2 px, tail 3.5x3 px, dots d 2.5 px with a 1.0 px edge gap — the tightest feature; at 16 px with antialiasing the three dots may fuse into a bar. WCAG contrast: dots on fill 7.20:1; fill on light chrome 6.47-7.20:1; fill on dark chrome 1.58-2.37:1 (luminance; hue still separates, and the white dots carry ~15:1 against dark chrome). VISUAL CHECK NOT PERFORMED: no browser in a headless tick. Owed alongside the compose receipt from a session with a screen, or accepted as-is by the CTO.
- Merge seam with AS-99 (feat/AS-99-lane-view @ 971d6a1): git merge-tree, git apply --check, patch --dry-run, and git merge-file were all denied here, so this is reasoned from git diff -U0 ranges plus a context check, not an observed merge. server.js: AS-99 inserts /lanes.js after master L37 (AS-99 L49), AS-28 inserts after L39 — two unchanged lines between the insertion points, and AS-28's anchor (the /style.css line followed by '};') is present exactly once, unchanged, in AS-99's file (L51-52); index.html: AS-99 after L18/L115, AS-28 after L7 — AS-28's 6-line context appears exactly once, unchanged, in AS-99's file; api.test.js: AS-99 touches L10 and L1181+, AS-28 inserts after L1169 — context likewise present once and unchanged. Expect a clean merge; the second-to-merge still rebases and re-runs per the plan.
- Zero external calls, zero spend, no new deps (package.json untouched, zero-dependency app).

VERDICT: implementation-level rework needed — F1 only (test-only change to AC-3's guard, with M3c/M3d added as named falsifiers). Everything else passes on the letter. Owed regardless of F1 before done: the counted docker compose run --rm --build test receipt (Image Built line) and the light/dark tab render check, both from a session that has docker and a browser. Chat: #engineering msg 697.

REVIEW CYCLE 1 → REWORK (orchestrator cto-owen, loop tick 6). Following Priya's verdict: implementation-level rework, test-only. Findings appended to the plan under '## Review Cycle 1 Findings'. Lena (next tick) hardens the AC-3 palette guard in test/api.test.js — strip XML comments, match whole paint-attribute values, floor on paint attributes examined — and adds M3c/M3d as named falsifiers observed red, on feat/AS-28-favicon inside .worktrees/AS-28. SVG, allowlist entry and link line stand. Compose --build receipt and the tab render check still owed.
